scope: Supplied Android/iOS8.4.1 shared source-content; static only, no live school account

facts.claim: Justification page descriptor is premium; container refuses fetch for broken, student or nonpremium current account.
Student helper tests group 8 or student; null/missing group returns false. This negative helper is not a positive complete parent authorization check.
Attendance per-lesson shortcut requires TypeId exact string1 plus nonstudent and available module; JST nonpremium hides it. Click redirects nonpremium to purchase.
Day shortcut is offered when any entry has TypeId string1 and passes role/availability gates; it preselects whole selected day.
Detail shortcut uses explicit detail synergiaAccountId for role, premium, availability and composer accountLogin.
Composer defaults ChosenDays, empty text/checkedLessons, sendNotification false and current local-offset date for all three date fields.
Whole-day shortcut sets start/end/single same date. Attendance shortcut chooses ChosenLessons and strict-matches timetable lessonNo against attendance.Lesson; mismatch falls back ChosenDays.
Date values use local datepicker and YYYY-MM-DD formatting. End date min is start; on start>=end, end is replaced by start.
Explicit validation requires chosen lesson(s)/single date or start/end with end not before start. No maximum days/backdating bound or nonempty body check exists in this validator.
facts.evidence_type: bounded negative observation over complete validator/date controls

facts.claim: Reason textarea has maxlength1000 but is not checked for nonempty by send confirmation validator.

Selected-day request goes through timetables store and getTimetablesFromSingleDay, GET /Timetables?day={date}; composer maps every returned view item subject/lessonNo without absence-type or cancellation filtering.

Timetable lessonNo can contain original/new lesson numbers separated by the U+F2EE icon; composer parseInt(base10) can retain only numeric prefix. Submitted lessons are lesson numbers, not record IDs.
Changing single date clears checked lessons, starts async lookup and maps result; no request-generation guard appears in this composer handler.
facts.evidence_type: bounded negative observation over complete onSingleDatePicked handler

facts.claim: Notification checkbox appears when today is same/before last day of ChosenDays range, or same/before single chosen day. Past-only submission forces sendNotify false; default is false.
ChosenDays POST contains messageFromParent, lessons empty array, dateFrom, dateTo, sendNotify. ChosenLessons uses identical keys with parseInt lesson-number array and equal date bounds.
Create is POST /Justifications, returning response.data. Synergia helper JSON-stringifies truthy object data; this path does not set sendFile or multipart.
Store chooses linked-account axios by login, POSTs, then reads response.Id uppercase to GET detail. UI reports success only when both POST and detail flow resolve.
Any rejection in POST-plus-detail chain produces server Message if provided or generic not-sent UI. This does not establish whether POST reached server.
List GET dateFrom/dateTo and detail GET /{id} both consume response.data.data. Multi-ID wrapper normalizes singleton data to array.

Attachment flag GET exists, consuming response.data.canSendAttachment, but composer state, control and call are commented; no active import/caller/upload construction found in this bounded firstparty source search.
facts.evidence_type: bounded call-site search plus commented-source observation

facts.claim: Builder maps11 response fields plus account login; messageFromParent falsey values become null, while ORM declares string defaults. DTO primary key is account login plus Id.
Container lists send in sent group, accept/reject in processed group. Other statuses match neither group; detail/item fallback labels every non-send/non-accept status rejected.
Detail displays date interval/status/count/reason/attachment boolean/post date, not attached file bytes. Literal string null and null reason are hidden.
Detail loads first class teacher display name for message prefill. Generic envelope can open mail composer; this is a follow-up message, not justification acceptance/edit.
Cached nonempty clean list is returned by login and Deleted false. Cold date bounds use prior schoolyear Sep1 through school end; missing end fallback is2000-09-01 to2999-01-01.
403 detection inspects error.message text and marks module unavailable per login; other errors do not imply denied. UI sorts PostDate descending after retrieval.
Module availability check uses one module-global promise, not a per-login map. When another check is active, it returns resolved promise without joining owner-specific result.
Local markAsSeen saves model only. Local delete marks Deleted; no HTTP deletion in these store actions.
Justification changes produce feed events, resolving by login+resource ID; Edit is described as processed and other types as added.
Page key includes current linked login and lastChange so ordinary create/detail cache updates remount list; this does not prove attendance has been justified.
